title: Connection notices — above the message box

steps.path: Coming back to the phone after the connection dropped
steps.headline: "Reconnecting to your computer…" now sits just above the message box instead of at the top of the chat.
steps.changed: The notice moved from a row under the header to the band above the message box — the same spot and the same band style as the voice typing "Listening" strip and the model-download strip. Wording, the "Use this phone only" button (Android app only) and timing are unchanged.
steps.notice: The notice is right where your thumb and eyes already are when you type. The chat no longer starts lower to make room for it at the top.
steps.risk: While it shows, the chat area above the box is that much shorter at the bottom instead of the top, so the newest message sits a little higher.

steps.path: After a refresh that did not finish
steps.headline: "This conversation may be out of date" and its Refresh button moved to the same band above the message box.
steps.changed: Same move as the reconnecting notice; the amber dot, the explanation and the Refresh button are the same.
steps.notice: Refresh is now next to where you type, so retrying is one short reach.

steps.path: Opening a conversation the phone has not loaded yet, or just after reconnecting
steps.headline: "Catching up with your computer…" moved above the message box too.
steps.changed: Same move. "Waiting for your computer…" (the computer slow to answer) and the short "Up to date." after a refresh move the same way; they are the same band with different words.
steps.notice: Every connection notice now appears in one place, so you learn to glance at one spot.

steps.path: Remote access opened on a laptop or tablet, while reconnecting
steps.headline: On a wide screen the notice also sits above the message box, the full width of the box.
steps.changed: Same move at a wide width. Your computer's own YouCoded window never shows these notices — nothing there changes.
steps.notice: Same place as on the phone.
steps.risk: Like the other bands, it does not show in terminal view — the same as before, when it lived at the top of the chat.
